conclusions.text: The retained full batch contains 318 exact component IDs mapped to 122 family locators; current complete refreshed membership evidence keeps all 318 unresolved.
The 30 contract-prioritized cases are source-feature/current-target-feature bound to seven exact Atlas-consumed simplified administrative products and preserved existing comparison rows.
Accepted physical class, current physical status, causal mechanism, legal or administrative authority, and repair eligibility remain unresolved; no approval or repair is asserted.
